title: Discovery call where the user's earlier statement conflicts with the client
purpose: Scope an integration between the client's CRM and our billing system
objectives: Which CRM edition do they use?

brief.text: Client: Fernwood Media (fictional). Our integration needs CRM API access, which some editions lack.

sources.title: Integration requirements
sources.text: Integration needs REST API access. API access is available on Professional and Enterprise editions, not on Starter.

turns.text: I assumed you're on the Enterprise edition, so API access shouldn't be a problem.
Actually we're on Starter, we downgraded in spring to save money.
Our admin says we can use the API with a workaround through Zapier.

mustInclude: Corrects the user's earlier assumption: Starter does not include API access according to the integration notes
Raises that the Zapier workaround is unverified for this integration and may need checking, marked uncertain
mustNotInclude: Says API access is available on their edition
States that Zapier definitely works or definitely fails as fact
checkpoints.ideal: Correct the earlier assumption: Starter lacks API access; ask whether upgrading or the Zapier route is acceptable and check the latter.
